goal: Drive population from measurable coverage gaps instead of subject-level placeholders.
quality_rules: Prefer authoritative, university, government, standards-body, museum, archive, or peer-reviewed sources.
Do not count a resource toward a cell unless its manifest explicitly maps to that exact subsubject and level.
Do not mark a cell mature with only a generic repository link when named resources are reasonably available.
Research repositories are discovery layers; individual papers still require relevance, provenance, and license checks.
Track access and local-ingestion permissions separately from reference access.
Deduplicate equivalent resources across manifests by canonical URL and normalized title/provider.
Preserve the existing 12 core routing domains; V2 changes the 22-subject learning-resource layer only.

completion_definition.covered: At least one explicitly mapped resource exists for the cell.
completion_definition.healthy: The cell meets its level-specific minimum target with at least two resource types where applicable.
completion_definition.mature: The cell has a balanced mix of learning, practice/reference, and advanced/research resources appropriate to the level.
completion_definition.subject_complete: Every subsubject x level cell is at least healthy; no subject is declared complete solely because a manifest exists.
